children: Phillips Edison announced a 6.2% increase in its monthly distribution to $0.115 per share, annualized at $1.38.
Board approved monthly distributions of $0.115 per share for Sept–Nov 2026, paid Oct 1, Nov 3, Dec 1.
Increase equals a 6.2% rise over prior annualized rate, from $1.30 to $1.38 per share.
Distributions apply equally to operating partnership unit holders, subject to tax withholding.
This marks the sixth consecutive annual dividend increase, reflecting confidence in cash flows and operations.
